dedupe_keys.name: casernes du service departemental metropolitain d incendie et de secours sur le territoire du departement du rhone et de la metropole de lyon

description: Casernes du Service Départemental Métropolitain d'Incendie et de Secours sur le territoire du département du Rhône et de la Métropole de Lyon is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole de Lyon. Emergency centers of the Metropolitan Departmental Fire and Rescue Service with name, address, type of site (barracks, staff, helicopter base, guard barracks...), photo, grouping, section. Coverage: Métropole de Lyon. The portal shows the English title as "Barracks of the Service Départemental Métropolitain d'Incendie et de Secours on the territory of the Rhône department an" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Métropole de Lyon. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, SHP, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
